scope: eligible ordinary general D/R principal pair; retrospective archive; aggregator-created-plus-one-day availability proxy before election; not verified publication
share_units: D/(D+R), percentage points; not margin points
average: equal selected sample/question weight within race/window
universe: LV or RV after native LV>RV>adults per-sample question selection; no adults
partisan: retain and report flags; sensitivity excluding explicitly partisan rows; unknown not verified nonpartisan
minimum_coverage: each window >=2 samples and >=2 distinct named pollsters
performance: orientation * (observed D share - final D share); below -1pp, within inclusive +/-1pp, above +1pp
matched: shared pollsters in both windows; >=2 shared; equal pollster means within each window
midpoint_sensitivity: same lead windows by actual field midpoint, requiring valid starts
uncertainty: descriptive only; race once per threshold; no independent D/R cases, no fit, no causal/model qualification
independent_earlier_trend: trend leads8to14 minus15to21; same final1to7 benchmark; >=2samplesand2pollsters in ALL3windows; matched requires2shared inALL3
midpoint_window_edges: continuous lead intervals [1,8),[8,15),[15,22); same intervals on integer field-end leads
